title: toai.chat gets the right credit
summary:
A little directory gardening: toai.chat has the right credit and details, and the project tables have been refreshed.

Corrected the project listing to credit @Veallym0n and link to the toai.chat repository.

The listing now describes toai.chat’s curl-based AI interaction, multimodal support, and MCP support. Its star count and submission date were also corrected.

Regenerated the project directory and README tables with the corrected listing. The refreshed tables add PairFusion and CraftUI and remove the Pollinations MCP Server row.
